title: Muñɗo oo
intro: Ko ɓooyi, e balɗe gadane daartol aadee, ruuhuuji ɗiɗi ina ndarii yeeso Tagɗo mum en e sadakeeji. Gooto jaɓaama, gooto jaɓaaka. Ko rewi heen koo wonata ko musiiba mawɗo gadano hakkunde banndiraaɓe - gollal gootal muñal e gollal gootal tooñannge mettunde. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade ko ngon-mi?
clues: Mi jibinaa ko e balɗe gadane nguurndam aadee e dow leydi
Miin ko mi ɓiɗɗo aadee gadano meeɗnooɗo yahde e oo aduna
Mi meeɗii waɗde sadak e nder jawdi am ɓurndi moƴƴude ngam weltinde Tagɗo am
Sadaka am jaɓaama gila dow, sadaka miñi am jaɓaaka
Nde njiylotonoo-mi maayde, mi suɓiima waasde ƴeftude junngo am e banndi am
Miin woni neɗɗo gadano e nder daartol aadee fof, mo goɗɗo wari e dow tooñannge

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: E sadak Ismaa'il mo Ibraahiima waɗi

location.label: Elemen keyɗo
options: Birniwol hoopoo ina jogii mesaas laamɗo

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Wonti ɓiɗɗo warngooji gadani e nder daartol aadee
Wuuri e ilam mawɗam e nder laana leɗɗe
Hoɗi ko e nder reedu liɗɗi mawɗi
Laamiima jinneeji, aadee en, e henndu
Waɗii duuɓi capanɗe tati e nder ladde mawnde
outcome.answer: Wonti ɓiɗɗo warngooji gadani e nder daartol aadee

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
